senses.zh: 企业家身份；企业家行为或精神
senses.en: the state of being an entrepreneur, or the activities or spirit associated with being an entrepreneur
examples: Individuals not only need to examine their personal finances but also the considerable lifestyle changes [[entrepreneurship]] can bring.

senses.zh: 风险项目；风险投资；冒险事业
senses.en: a new business activity that involves taking risks
examples: Another idea that has attracted [[venture]] capitalists' interest is online learning.

senses.zh: （对生活和世界的）看法，观点，态度
senses.en: general attitude to life and the world
examples: You will become more mature as your [[outlook]] on life is influenced by the books that you read.

senses.en: the desire to know about sth.
examples: In my view, intellectual [[curiosity]] is a sufficient reason for this new scientific endeavor.

senses.zh: 培养，养成（技能、态度或素质）
senses.en: work hard to develop a particular skill, attitude, or quality
examples: [[Cultivating]] a positive mental attitude toward yourself can reap tremendous benefits.
Near the coast, huge areas of land are given over to [[cultivating]] tomatoes.

senses.en: prepare and use land for growing crops and plants
examples: [[Cultivating]] a positive mental attitude toward yourself can reap tremendous benefits.
Near the coast, huge areas of land are given over to [[cultivating]] tomatoes.

senses.en: considering a person or thing as a whole, rather than as separate parts
examples: Policymakers need to take a long-term, [[holistic]] approach to the housing finance reform.

senses.en: the quality of being successful and working in the way that was intended
examples: There are doubts about the [[effectiveness]] of the new drug in treating the disease.

senses.zh: 唯一地；仅仅；独一无二地
senses.en: not involving anything or anyone else
examples: Too often we make buying decisions based [[solely]] upon what we see in advertisements.

senses.en: when a business or an activity makes a profit, or the amount of profit it makes
examples: Competition between firms will continue to force those prices down, which will undermine the [[profitability]] of the industry.

senses.en: supporting or based on the principles of capitalism
examples: In a [[capitalistic]] society, individuals with wealth and privilege have much of the power.

senses.zh: 开创性的；先驱的；探索性的
senses.en: (only before noun) introducing new and better methods or ideas for the first time
examples: Cowley's [[pioneering]] development of modern emergency medicine helped save countless lives.

senses.zh: 使最优化；使尽可能完善；使尽量有效
senses.en: (BrE optimise) improve the way that sth. is done or used so that it is as effective as possible
examples: Doctors are concentrating on understanding the disease better, and on [[optimizing]] the treatment.

senses.en: a company, organization, or business
examples: To a great many individuals setting up a new business [[enterprise]], the last thing they usually bother about is accounting and tax.

senses.zh: 令人高兴的；令人满意的
senses.en: pleasing and satisfying
examples: It must be very [[gratifying]] to see all your children grown-up and happy.

senses.en: the quality of being able to continue for a long time
examples: "Do you want environmental [[sustainability]] or do you want economic advantage?" asked McConnell.

senses.en: move, drive, or push sth. forward
examples: The rocket is attached to the spacecraft and is designed to [[propel]] it toward Mars.

senses.zh: 革命性的；突破性的；创新的
senses.en: completely new and different, esp. in a way that leads to great improvements
examples: The 20th century brought about [[revolutionary]] changes in our lifestyles.

senses.zh: 重要性，意义（尤指对将来的影响）
senses.en: the importance of an event, action, etc., esp. because of the effect or influence it will have in the future
examples: The discovery of the new drug is of great [[significance]] for people suffering from heart problems.

senses.zh: 市场（指涉及营销的种种活动）
senses.en: (the ~) the part of business activity that is concerned with buying and selling goods in competition with other companies
examples: Some retailers worry that new regulations will hurt their ability to compete in the [[marketplace]].

senses.en: a strong permanent influence on sb. / sth.
examples: Gandhi was a tremendously brave man whose unique form of courage left a lasting [[imprint]] on India's history.
She could clearly see the [[imprint]] of her fingers on his pale wrist.

senses.en: the mark left by an object being pressed into or onto sth.
examples: Gandhi was a tremendously brave man whose unique form of courage left a lasting [[imprint]] on India's history.
She could clearly see the [[imprint]] of her fingers on his pale wrist.

senses.en: feeling sympathy for people who are suffering
examples: The public's response to the crisis was generous and [[compassionate]].

senses.zh: （某人不再工作或去世后）留下的成果
senses.en: sth. that sb. has achieved that continues to exist after they stop working or die
examples: Perhaps her most important [[legacy]] was her program of educational reform.

senses.en: a sensible and careful attitude that makes you avoid unnecessary risks
examples: Businessmen are showing remarkable [[prudence]] in investing in the region.

senses.en: finally, after everything else has been done or considered
examples: Everything will [[ultimately]] depend on what is said at the meeting with the directors next week.

senses.zh: 意味着（某事可能是真的）
senses.en: if a fact, event, etc. implies sth., it shows that it is likely to be true
examples: These findings do not [[imply]] that urbanization makes little or no difference to the small towns.

senses.en: involving a combination of social and economic factors
examples: The age, education, and [[socioeconomic]] status of these young mothers led to less satisfactory childcare.

senses.zh: 理解，领悟（复杂或困难的事物）
senses.en: understand sth. that is complicated or difficult
examples: In an effort to [[comprehend]] the principles of investment of any sort, you have to know the way to determine the return on investment.

senses.en: extremely large
examples: Regular visits from a social worker can be of [[immense]] value to elderly people living alone.

senses.zh: 拥有，具有（某品质或能力）
senses.en: (fml.) have a particular quality or ability
examples: I'm afraid he doesn't [[possess]] a sense of humor.
Because of his gambling, he lost everything he [[possessed]].

senses.en: (fml.) have or own sth.
examples: I'm afraid he doesn't [[possess]] a sense of humor.
Because of his gambling, he lost everything he [[possessed]].

senses.en: (fml.) ask for sth. in an emotional way
examples: If you feel depressed for more than three weeks, I [[implore]] you to seek professional help.

senses.zh: 使彻底变革；给···带来革命
senses.en: (BrE revolutionise) completely change the way people do sth. or think about sth.
examples: The company [[revolutionized]] the market for watches with its inexpensive watches aimed at the youth market.

senses.zh: （刚提及的两个人或物中的）后者
senses.en: (the ~) (fml.) the second of two people or things just mentioned
examples: Where unemployment and crime are high, it can be assumed that the [[latter]] is due to the former.

senses.en: developing well and being successful
examples: A stable and [[flourishing]] economy is essential for political stability and national security, and vice versa.

senses.en: unwilling to change ideas or behavior
examples: We were disappointed that they insisted on such a [[rigid]] interpretation of the rules.

senses.zh: 小心的；费尽心思的；精心的
senses.en: (usu. before noun) very careful and thorough
examples: It is the kind of [[painstaking]] work that only someone who knows every inch of the ship could perform.

senses.en: quality, ability, or achievement that is average or below average
examples: We will not accept [[mediocrity]]; the job they do is of critical importance.

senses.en: (~ to sb. / sth.) strange and frightening; different from what you are used to
examples: In a world that had suddenly become [[alien]] and dangerous, Michael was her only security.
In short, he concluded that the canals were artificial constructs of technologically advanced [[alien]] beings.

senses.en: connected with creatures from another world
examples: In a world that had suddenly become [[alien]] and dangerous, Michael was her only security.
In short, he concluded that the canals were artificial constructs of technologically advanced [[alien]] beings.

senses.en: find out about sth. that has been kept secret
examples: The investigation [[uncovered]] evidence of a large-scale illegal trade in wild birds.

senses.en: very important or serious, esp. because there may be important results
examples: Whether or not to move overseas is a [[momentous]] decision for the family.

senses.en: be caused by sth. or start from sth.
examples: His grief sprang from the loss of the most important love he had ever known in his life.

senses.en: show clearly that sth. happened or exists
examples: Her skin spoke of warm summer days spent in the sun.

senses.en: do or discover sth. new
examples: Inventing such a camera wouldn't be easy, but Cameron said he was ready to break new ground.

senses.zh: 约翰 • 凯奇（美国音乐家）
邵逸夫（中国香港企业家、慈善家）
